syllabus: A writ of error to review judgment of the highest court of a State dismissed for want of jurisdiction, on authority of Castillo v. McConnico, 168 U. S. 674; no Federal question was suggested prior to petition for writ of error.
summary: ERROR TO THE SUPREME COURT OP THE STATE OP IOWA.
attorneys: Mr. Chester C. Cole for plaintiff in error., No appearance for defendant in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Writ of error dismissed for the want of jurisdiction. Castillo v. McConnico, 168 U. S. 674. No Federal question suggested prior to petition for writ of error. Case below, 135 Iowa, 597.
